item.title: What’s a Cabin Cruise? Everything You Need to Know Before Booking
item.description: Imagine waking up to the sound of water gently lapping against the hull, stepping outside, and diving straight into a clear, turquoise ocean. For a long time, enjoying a holiday like this meant you either needed a lifetime of sailing experience or the budget to rent a whole private vessel with a captain. Now, travelers can book a cabin cruise and experience the magic of a sailing vacation to an exotic destination for the price of a single hotel room. Even better, sailing experience is not required. You simply book your cabin, step aboard, and leave the work to the crew on board the yacht. Before you pack your bags and head for the marina, here is everything you need to know about this effortless way to explore the world. What Is a Cabin Cruise? A cabin cruise, also called a by-the-cabin sailing charter , is a style of travel where you rent a private stateroom or cabin on a yacht. The rest of the vessel is shared with a small group of like-minded travelers, so you have opportunities to socialize in between exploring islands and relaxing in your room. Every cabin charter trip features a carefully planned route, shared communal spaces, delicious meals, and a professional crew to run the ship. It’s an easy way to dip your toes into the yachting lifestyle. What Is a Cabin Charter Like? The entire travel process is designed to be stress-free from the moment you book your cabin cruise vacation to the day you head home. Choosing Your Destination and Dates Your journey begins by selecting where you want to sail and picking the dates that fit your schedule. These trips follow set itineraries, which you can view ahead of time. This way, you can see which ports you’ll visit and plan ahead of time. Arrival and Boarding When you arrive at the marina base, the crew will welcome you aboard and show you to your private stateroom. After a quick safety briefing and an introduction to the yacht, the captain casts off the lines and sets sail. Your Cruise Each day follows a relaxing rhythm of sailing, swimming, exploring hidden coves, and enjoying fresh meals on deck. While the captain handles the sailing, you share the spacious decks with your fellow passengers. Do You Need Sailing Experience? With this type of sailing vacation, no experience is required. You do not need to know how to tie a single knot, read a navigation chart, or handle a steering wheel. The price of your cabin includes the services of the captain and crew. They take care of navigation, weather tracking, anchoring, and all daily shipboard operations. The only thing you need to do the entire week is relax and have fun. What’s Included in a Cabin Yacht Charter? Inclusions vary based on the package you choose and the company you book with. Premium options, such as Dream Yacht ’s cabin cruises, typically include: A private, comfortable double cabin with its own bathroom Access to all shared yacht spaces, like the forward trampolines, salon, and sun decks The full services of a professional captain and cook Onboard water toys, which may include things like snorkeling gear, paddleboards, and kayaks Before booking, be sure to check the trip details to confirm inclusions and what you might need to cover during your cruise. Food, Beverages, and Culinary Options Many packages offer a half-board plan, which includes select meals such as breakfast and lunch. With half-board options, you may dine ashore at ports where you drop anchor. Other packages feature a full-board plan, which means breakfast, lunch, and dinner are included. Optional Excursions and Extras Depending on where you are sailing, you might have the option to add on excursions like guided island hikes and historical tours. It is always a good idea to check your specific package details before booking, so you know exactly what is covered and what extras you might want to explore. item.title: Four Places You Can Rediscover the True Spirit of Adventure
item.description: For your next vacation, turn up the dial on adventure by handing over your itinerary research to us. When you book one of our yacht charter packages, you’ll enjoy photo-worthy highlights, exciting excursions, delicious cuisine and memorable experiences carefully selected by our destination specialists. In your downtime you can relax on a premium yacht with spacious lounge and deck areas before retreating to your private double cabin with its own bathroom. There are +15 destinations to choose from for our boat charter vacations , including the Caribbean, Indian Ocean, Pacific, Asia and Mediterranean. You’ll get to make new like-minded friends as you set off on an experience of a lifetime while our captain and chef will look after you. Get to know our latest routes… Extended vacation in the Grenadines Following the popularity of our Dream Grenadines premium 8 day charter , we’ve listened to requests for an extended tour of the Grenadines and introduced our new Dream Grenadines Premium 11 day charter . Your vacation will stop by: Martinique Bequia Mustique Tobago Cays and the marine park Petite St. Vincent Morpion Mayreau Palm Island Union St. Vincent Canouan Saint Lucia Saint Anne Optional excursions include: Mustique island tour and swim at Macaroni beach, lobster BBQ at Tobago Cays and visit to a local bar to hear a steel band, tour of St. Vincent and swim under a cascade of water, tour of St. Lucia including volcano crater, sulfur springs and botanical gardens. The Grenadines is such a wonderful part of the world with much to see and do without traveling far. Get your Caribbean sun booked in for this year and then all you have to do is check out the flights and pack your bags. Our new treat in Tahiti We’ve been offering French Polynesia by the cabin charters for a while with our Papeete 11 day charter , Huahine 4 day charter and Bora Bora 4 days and 8 day charters . New for 2018, we’ve added our Rangiroa Dream 6 day charter . Now you can explore Tahiti’s Tuamotus archipelago with its sandy motus, coral gardens and bounty of marine life to snorkel. During your vacation, you will discover: Mahanahana for kayaking and snorkeling Kauraufara fishing village and shell beach Sables Rose and coral garden Motu Teu and Bird Island with its thousands of birds Otepipi, a deserted village Motu Faama Blue lagoon and marine life Tiputa Pass and dolphin watching Tahiti is a special place full of romance where you can enjoy peace and quiet away from crowds and let us spoil you. New Cabin Charters in the Bahamas We’ve recently announced our new Exumas Dream 8 day charter from Nassau. It’s just a short hop before you hit the first of the Exumas cays where you’ll be met with white-sand beaches, surprising wildlife, protected marine reserves, Hollywood movie sets and even a former drug baron’s hideout. Your charter package includes visiting: Palm cay Highbourne Cay Allen Cay Warderick Wells Cay & Exuma Cays Land & Sea Park Staniel Cay Big Major Spot Bay with the swimming pigs Thunderball grotto Shroud Cay Norman’s Cay This region is famous for its stromatolite reefs, some of the oldest living examples on earth, as well as coral reefs teeming with tropical fish. Relax in the Balearic Islands If you want a European experience, head to Mallorca for our Palma Dream 8 day charter . You’ll find a relaxed pace of life, fantastic weather (with 300 sunny days annually) and a tour of the archipelago off Spain’s Iberian peninsula with 500km of coastline. Your cruise will include: Palma Cala Portal Vells Cala Pi Colonia Sant Jordi Cala Figuera Porto Petro Cala Santanyi Cabrera Es Trenc Beach Sa Rapita You’ll find golden beaches, medieval history, gothic cathedrals, quaint fishing ports and clear waters that are perfect for swimming and snorkeling.
